en.html:
The Lords of Sasagawa and Horigoe were back from Aizu. Another meeting of the leadership, then.

Since the last one, matters had moved forward.

en.html:
Doushin"...With this, His Highness Kuniuji's appointment as Lord General is settled. For a start, congratulations!"
Raichou"Now only the imperial envoy must arrive, and we hold the ceremony."
Shishiku"The date is fixed as well?"
Doushin"Indeed it is."
Chachamaru"Rokuhara, full comeback. No, better than that—Mark Two. Improved model."
Shishiku"And at the same time, our decisive battle with the occupation forces begins."
Chachamaru"Neo-Rokuhara in immediate danger. Arre wah, what a launch."
Shishiku"No danger. This time we win."
Doushin"Win, we must... There is no getting around it."
Raichou"…………"

ja.html:
童心「……これで邦氏殿下への大将領宣下は確定。 　まずは、めでたい！」
雷蝶「後は勅使を迎えて式典を執り行うだけです わね」
獅子吼「その日取りも決まったのだな？」
童心「いかにも」
茶々丸「六波羅完全復活やね。 　いや、むしろ改良型マークツー」
獅子吼「と同時に、進駐軍との決戦が始まる」
茶々丸「いきなり危うし。新生六波羅ネオロクハラ」
獅子吼「危うくはない。 　今度はこちらが勝つ」
童心「勝たねば――なるまいなァ」
雷蝶「…………」
